raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of atomic structure components, particularly by incorrectly stating the atomic mass as the sum of protons and electrons instead of protons and neutrons, leading to an incorrect solution. This mistake reflects a conceptual misunderstanding of atomic mass calculation principles where the electron mass is negligible when determining the atomic mass of an atom.
